parameters.jsonBody:
{
  "tool_config": {
    "type": "webhook",
    "name": "get_indicative_quote",
    "description": "Return a Unica pre-quote. Call with mode quick after one or two basics for a rough ballpark, then again with mode precise once more rating fields are collected. Returns estimate (single number), indicative_range, refine_with (fields that would sharpen it), status and missing_fields.",
    "response_timeout_secs": 20,
    "api_schema": {
      "url": "https://ai-process.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/unica-quote-v3",
      "method": "POST",
      "request_body_schema": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": ["line_of_business"],
        "properties": {
          "line_of_business": { "type": "string", "description": "Insurance type, DE or EN: Kfz, Haftpflicht, Haushalt, Rechtsschutz, Lebensversicherung" },
          "mode": { "type": "string", "description": "quick for a rough ballpark, precise for the exact pre-quote" },
          "name": { "type": "string", "description": "Caller name" },
          "phone": { "type": "string", "description": "Caller phone number" },
          "email": { "type": "string", "description": "Caller email" },
          "region": { "type": "string", "description": "City or postal code" },
          "age": { "type": "number", "description": "life: age of the insured person" },
          "coverage": { "type": "string", "description": "car: haftpflicht/teilkasko/vollkasko; home: plus; legal: kombi; life: vorsorge" },
          "driver_age": { "type": "number", "description": "car: age of the main driver" },
          "power_kw": { "type": "number", "description": "car: engine power in kW" },
          "vehicle_value": { "type": "number", "description": "car: vehicle value in EUR (for Kasko)" },
          "claims_free_years": { "type": "number", "description": "car: number of claim-free years" },
          "num_drivers": { "type": "number", "description": "car: number of drivers" },
          "bonus_malus": { "type": "number", "description": "car: 0.5 best to 1.8 worst, optional" },
          "household": { "type": "string", "description": "liability: single or family" },
          "contents_value": { "type": "number", "description": "home_contents: sum insured in EUR" },
          "security": { "type": "string", "description": "home_contents: alarm if an alarm system exists" },
          "sum_assured": { "type": "number", "description": "life: cover amount in EUR" },
          "term_years": { "type": "number", "description": "life: term length in years" },
          "tobacco": { "type": "boolean", "description": "life: is the person a smoker" }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
